### ITW Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Webcast


10/15/2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s204.q4cdn.com/218186261/files/doc_news/2026/10/ITW-Schedules-Third-Quarter-2026-Earnings-Webcast.pdf)


GLENVIEW, Ill., Oct. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Illinois Tool Works Inc. (NYSE: ITW) will issue its third quarter 2026 results on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 7:00 a.m. CDT. Following the release, ITW will hold its third quarter 2026 earnings webcast at 9:00 a.m. CDT.


To access the webcast for the event, please click on the following link:
[ITW Q3 2026 Earnings Webcast](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=O6wn1-8RZCQOkKMCf91L3GGcAosoNdeh0Xm3wXB7XA5Baga-hbaHKXNQKEWFm_7saPV_d4S0d4xZwkxQVj17vM5zVOJapL6cwlK0qi6i9-RyQub5MjCnY0HqqDhdGSK1ORai7XnN0iEgx1TUARcr1Q==)


If you are a participant on the conference call, please dial 1-833-461-5787 (domestic) or 1-585-542-9983 (international) 10 minutes prior to the 9:00 a.m. CDT start time. The meeting id is 460987187.


Following the webcast, presentation materials and an audio webcast replay will be available at[http://investor.itw.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=dLMnnsXMubVPy7JbDRviBBkgcfXu8BnqkrZTv03P7Fb5WtZMUT5B9YFwTFpjGWyoXNK9C-1ZVA0NohtaHWOImoMYrSyFnmLFVbSZQIIZ_jk=) .


**About Illinois Tool Works**


ITW (NYSE: ITW) is a Fortune 300 global multi-industrial manufacturing leader with revenue of $16 billion in 2025. The company’s seven industry-leading segments leverage the unique ITW Business Model to drive solid growth with best-in-class margins and returns in markets where highly innovative, customer-focused solutions are required. ITW’s approximately 43,000 dedicated colleagues around the world thrive in the company’s decentralized and entrepreneurial culture.[www.itw.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=rpFt_t3H3_nfKjjjcH4XR4yADz2Xa86UmkE3d9IcKEDprZ2-Scoif2XS72iCRTzMrSmriqslYFIblV1NhfMwNg==) .
